Questions

What is the cheapest verified AI API with ≥128K context?

As of 2026-11-07, among 54 verified text models with context ≥128K in the Ratecard table, the cheapest by published input then output list price is OpenRouter Llama 4 Scout (Meta) at $0.10 input / $0.30 output per 1M tokens, context 1.31M. Units: USD per 1M tokens. Verified rows only. OpenRouter rows are that gateway’s list price (may differ from the upstream provider). Long-context rule: if this page’s threshold exceeds a model’s published long_context threshold (highest applicable of long_context_tiers when present), the long-tier rates are shown.

How are these rows ranked?

Verified text models only (status=verified, kind=text, published input price, sourced context ≥ the page threshold). Sorted by effective input $/1M tokens, then effective output $/1M. No volume blend, no cache hit assumption, no batch. Each row links its official source and check date.

When do long-context rates apply on these pages?

If the page threshold (128K) is above a model’s published long_context threshold (or the highest of several long_context_tiers), we show that tier’s input/output/cached rates — the same rule the home finder and calculator use (promptTokens > threshold). Example: OpenAI gpt-6-luna standard is cheaper below 272K, but the ≥1M page uses its >272K tier. Claude Haiku 5.5 uses its >100K tier on both the ≥128K and ≥1M pages. OpenRouter Qwen3.7 Flash has two steps (≥32K and ≥256K); the ≥128K page uses ≥32K rates and the ≥1M page uses ≥256K rates.

Are OpenRouter prices the same as the upstream provider?

No. OpenRouter rows are the gateway’s own published list price, which may differ from the upstream provider. They are labeled OpenRouter and link OpenRouter’s source.

Do these pages include unverified models?

No. Unverified rows (price not readable from the official page on the check date) are excluded so the ranking stays citable. Use the home finder with “Include unverified rows” if you need them.

Data: /api/models.json (CC BY 4.0). Regenerated from the same dataset as the home finder. List prices before taxes and negotiated discounts. Always verify on the provider’s page before buying.
